caption: The video captures a close-up of a candlelit table. Two hands, one from a white cuff in the foreground and the other from a dark blue suit sleeve at right, each hold a stemmed glass of pale white wine. The glasses are tilted toward one another, starting separated before their bowls overlap in a toast. Throughout the excerpt the pair drifts rightward and slightly upward. The foreground bowl slides from a left position to rest centrally over the background bowl. The wine surfaces and refracted highlights shift subtly as the glasses move, while the lit taper candle flickers beside a folded napkin and a red rose. Green grapes sit at lower right, and the blurred brown background slides with the framing. The glasses remain overlapping for the rest of the visible portion.
